governingDecisions: Travel/TinySkies remains the macro world and productive runtime owner.
The /world/ path is a POC/design donor for authoring UX, not a second world owner.
POC output flows as Candidate World Recipe → Travel validation → possible promotion.
Authoring and locomotion remain separate axes: PLAY|BUILD|GOD versus GROUND|FLIGHT|DRIVE.
BlockBits/Voxel is a local construction/terraforming tool, not the replacement world aesthetic.
Asset Registry/Librarian remains read-only source/discovery owner; Builder/POC consumes candidate bundles.
Resident Atlas remains source owner for resident-scene composition candidates; Prefab Lab consumes but does not rewrite that truth.
Source assets are never silently edited; scale/look corrections remain explicit overrides.
The POC must not invent competing terrain, movement, registry, animation-compatibility or productive save truth.

cleanRoomDonor.name: SP13KTRA
cleanRoomDonor.license: All rights reserved. Observation-only donor. Do not copy, port, modify or derive code/assets/data tables without permission.
observations: Compact authored route skeleton → derive dense road geometry, banking, hills, racing line, cues and gameplay markings.
Route metadata is a reference, not a cage: vehicles still simulate in world coordinates.
Correlated spatial fields create districts/ridges better than per-object random noise.
A zone can use one dominant shape language/palette plus limited secondary variation.
Procedural SFX/ambience can be a coherent glue layer while hero music remains authored/Suno-based.
Seeded music/world candidates become useful when paired with a human seed browser/curation step.
Bake/compile stable world results once; rebuild only affected authoring state when the recipe changes.
Canonical assets provide identity; procedural geometry can provide connective tissue.
forbidden: No copied source code or algorithms line-for-line.
No copied constants, circuit data, seed tables, music parameter tables or shape implementations.
No claim that SP13KTRA code is a permissible implementation donor.
Independent KFB implementations must be written from KFB requirements and our own contracts.

changelog.text: Added Resident Prefab Lab: consume kfb-resident-scene.v1, load exact pinned child assets as one grouped ensemble, transform root, ungroup/edit/regroup, local roundtrip and candidate residentPrefabs export. No productive owner changed.

Added Route Lab: neutral-pad ROAD control-point placement/editing, line preview, undo/finish/cancel, local save/reload and candidate spline JSON. Productive terrain conformance/road geometry remain Travel-owned.
Added Object Composer: real GLB/GLTF candidate import, click placement, TransformControls, local ground snap, duplicate/delete/frame, local save/reload, copy/download candidate recipe.
Clarified /world/ as POC/Design Lab. Output path is POC → Candidate World Recipe → Travel validation; no competing terrain, movement, registry or save truth.
Accepted WSA split: World POC moves fast on authoring feel; Travel WB0 owns runtime, owner contracts, persistence and promotion.
Created durable /world/ planning surface so fresh chats recover from one public URL instead of pasted mega-briefings.
Added SP13KTRA as observation-only donor with explicit all-rights-reserved boundary and independent KFB implementation rules.
Recorded existing WB0 implementation/evidence; no new runtime owner introduced.
